title: CVE-2026-108334 — Github.com/kuadrant/kuadrant-operator/internal/wasm: github.com/rh-api-management/rhcl-operator-product-build/kuadrant-…
summary: Affected: Red Hat Connectivity Link 1.4, Red Hat Connectivity Link 1, Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI) A flaw was found in the internal WebAssembly (WASM) shim used by the Kuadrant operator. When generating the CEL predicate that determines whether Gateway-level authentication and rate limiting should run, the shim does not correctly escape values from HTTPRoute match fields. A user who can create or modify an HTTPRoute attached to a shared Gateway can provide a crafted path, header, or query match value that causes the predicate to skip those checks. The request is still forwarded to the route’s backend.

title: CVE-2026-110889 — WordPress Gantry 5 Framework plugin <= 5.6.4 - Sensitive Data Exposure vulnerability
summary: Affected: Gantry 5 Framework Generation of Error Message Containing Sensitive Information vulnerability in Gantry Gantry 5 Framework gantry5 allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects Gantry 5 Framework: from n/a through 5.6.4.

title: CVE-2026-93485 — WordPress Core <= 7.1 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
summary: Affected: Automattic WordPress Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Automattic WordPress wordpress allows DOM-Based XSS.This issue affects WordPress: from n/a through 7.1.

title: CVE-2026-110936
summary: Affected: Siemens Software Center A vulnerability has been identified in Siemens Software Center (All versions < V4.0.9.8). The affected application loads dynamic-link libraries (DLLs) from an uncontrolled search path. This could allow an authenticated local attacker to place a specially crafted DLL in a directory that the application searches, leading to arbitrary code execution with the privileges of the affected application.

title: CVE-2026-111110 — Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid <= 2.8.61 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting…
summary: Affected: stiofansisland Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid The Payment forms, Buy now buttons, and Invoicing System | GetPaid plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'mmdwqzpoxadd' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.8.61 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The required nonce (getpaid_form_nonce) is publicly emitted to all visitors via wp_localize_script as WPInv.formNonce, meaning no authentication or prior nonce leak is needed; the stored payload fires when an administrator views the affected invoice's Payment Form Details metabox.

title: CVE-2026-110253 — weForms <= 1.6.28 - Unauthenticated Limited Media File Deletion via 'wpuf_files' Parameter
summary: Affected: boldgrid weForms – Easy Drag & Drop Contact Form Builder For WordPress The weForms – Easy Drag & Drop Contact Form Builder For WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to limited media file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the weforms_delete_entry_attachments function in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.28 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary media files on the server. This requires an administrator to permanently delete the poisoned form entry, a routine moderation action for spam-looking submissions that an attacker can prompt through social engineering.

title: CVE-2026-109983 — YMC Filter <= 3.12.19 - Authenticated (Author+) Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via 'post_title' Parameter
summary: Affected: wssoffice21 YMC Filter The YMC Filter plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored DOM-Based Cross-Site Scripting via the 'post_title' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.12.19 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The autocomplete REST endpoint is registered with a permission callback that unconditionally returns true, meaning any site visitor — including unauthenticated users — can trigger the payload simply by typing in the YMC filter search box, while only Author-level access is required to store it.

title: CVE-2026-100316 — European VAT Compliance Assistant for WooCommerce <= 1.36.10 - Unauthenticated Stored Cross-Site Scripting via CF-IPCou…
summary: Affected: davidanderson European VAT Compliance Assistant for WooCommerce The European VAT Compliance Assistant for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via CF-IPCountry Header in all versions up to, and including, 1.36.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The malicious header value is persisted verbatim into order post-meta during a guest checkout, meaning no account or authentication is required to plant the payload.

title: CVE-2026-110384 — WordPress Fancy Comments WordPress plugin <= 1.2.21 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability
summary: Affected: Heateor Support Fancy Comments WordPress Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Heateor Support Fancy Comments WordPress fancy-facebook-comments allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Fancy Comments WordPress: from n/a through 1.2.21.
